concerns.concern: The topological origin of the edge state is argued, not tested. A local STS probe cannot distinguish a helical edge from a trivial edge mode. The paper should measure edges of the trivial Si2Te2 on Sb2Te3 as a control and, if possible, probe edge conduction directly.
concerns.quote: "The observed spatial extent and robustness of the edge states provide strong evidence for their topological origin." (p. 4)

concerns.concern: The edge peak could be a trivial state from band bending or in-gap states. The edge spectra cover only about a third of the bulk gap, and the peak sits near the valence band edge. Above about +20 mV the edge signal falls below the center signal, and no magnetic-field test is shown. Edge spectra up to the conduction band edge and maps at several in-gap energies are needed.
concerns.quote: Showing the edge spectra up to the conduction band edge near 290 meV would speak directly to this lookalike.

concerns.concern: The ring in the +7 mV map could be a feedback set-point artifact at the 7 Å island step, since the map was taken at a fixed set-point (Vstab = 0.2 V). The line cut that argues against this covers only one line on one island. A constant-height map or one at an out-of-gap set-point is needed, plus a comparison of tip paths climbing onto versus stepping down from the island.
concerns.quote: Repeat the Fig. 5(e) map at constant height or with Vstab outside the gap

concerns.concern: The bulk gap in the center spectrum of Fig. 5(b) (a V-shaped dip between ±50 mV) does not obviously match the gap of about -10 to 290 meV in the Fig. 4(a) inset. The island sizes used for each are not stated.
concerns.quote: How does the "V-shaped dip between ±50 mV" in the center spectrum of Fig. 5(b) relate to the gap from about -10 to 290 meV

concerns.concern: The shown islands and edges may be selected from a larger set. The paper does not say how many islands or edges were measured by STS, how many showed the peak, or whether any were set aside and why, and the cited Fig. S11 is missing from this version. The second-best edge should be shown in the main text.
concerns.quote: State how many islands and edges you measured and how many showed the peak, and show the second-best edge in the main text.

concerns.concern: The full parameter ranges measured are not disclosed. The paper shows only -0.1 to +0.1 V spectra and a single +7 mV map, without saying what other biases, map energies, set-points or island sizes were measured, or why these windows were chosen.
concerns.quote: The paper doesn't say what else was measured or why these windows were chosen.

concerns.concern: The processing steps from raw data to figures, and the data and code themselves, are not given and are deferred to Ref. 35.
concerns.quote: processing, data and code are deferred to Ref. 35.

concerns.concern: Ref. 35's description mentions three stripe orientations, which may be text copied from a different manuscript and should be checked.
concerns.quote: The stripe wording may come from another manuscript, so it is worth checking.
